summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Standard Lithium Ltd., a foreign private issuer, providing a quarterly update on its at-the-market (ATM) equity program. During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the company issued 3,139,330 common shares on NYSE American at an average price of US$3.59, raising gross proceeds of US$11,261,931. There is no special situation; it is a routine periodic update of ongoing capital market activities. No transaction, tender, or strategic change is reported.
